audit.why: 4/10 with Renekton owning levels 1-5 and Vladimir owning 2+ items matches 48.73% over 2526 games — a lane you must close before his scaling.
Spikes: Renekton levels 2-3, Dominus at 6, first item; Vladimir on Sanguine Pool rank-ups (28s down to 16s), first item, and 2 items with Zhonya's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated/wrong facts: 'Crimson Rush (empowered Q)' as an ability name, and Sanguine Pool called a '26-second' cooldown in two places.
audit.why: Crimson Pact is the passive; the empowered Q is Transfusion at full resource per Riot's text — no ability is named Crimson Rush in the kit. Sanguine Pool's real cooldown is 28/25/22/19/16 and it grants 2 seconds of untargetability.
audit.corrected: Name it empowered Transfusion; Sanguine Pool is 28s at rank 1, 2s untargetable.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] is headed 'Build MR + anti-heal' but its body said nothing about healing.
audit.why: Transfusion heals him and Hemoplague heals per champion hit; both carry the heal flag, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him — buy Executioner's early.

edits.before: Vladimir's level 1 Q harass is reliable but your Q sustain blunts it — farm safely and deny his Crimson Rush procs by standing behind minions to reduce his empowered-Q splash.
edits.after: Vladimir's level 1 Q harass is reliable but your Q sustain blunts it — Transfusion is a 9s cooldown at rank 1, so step up and trade in the window right after he casts it.

edits.before: Harass with Crimson Rush (empowered Q) to shave your HP bar so you cannot safely all-in without spending Fury on sustain
edits.after: Harass with empowered Transfusion to shave your HP bar so you cannot safely all-in without spending Fury on sustain

edits.before: He starts itemising into AP sustain and the Sanguine Pool cooldown becomes a core skill-check — time every engage around the 26-second window, not your own Fury.
edits.after: He starts itemising into AP sustain and the Sanguine Pool cooldown becomes a core skill-check — time every engage around the 28-second rank-1 window, not your Fury.

edits.before: Level 1 is genuinely even — Vladimir's Q harass hurts but your Q sustain nearly keeps pace, and neither of you has a real kill threat without his W or your E up. At level 2 you spike hard: E in, land the empowered W-stun before he can react, Q for the heal, then E back out. The goal is not an instant kill — it is banking a health deficit that forces him out of lane or a Flash. He will start baiting your E approach from level 3 onward to time his W pool; fake the engage, let him ghost-W into nothing, then immediately slice in on his 26-second cooldown and run the full pattern.

edits.before: Vladimir wastes Sanguine Pool — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Transfusion and Hemoplague both heal him — buy Executioner's early.

edits.before: Track Vladimir's Sanguine Pool: Dodges your burst. Bait it. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool is 2s untargetable on a 28s cooldown at rank 1 — bait it, then commit the stun.

notes: Level chart agrees across full, content and packet — no chart edits. Both packet-flagged suspect names were real errors and are fixed. I did not invent a name for Vladimir's empowered Q; Riot's text only says Transfusion is empowered at full resource, so that is the wording used.
